title: Napa & Sonoma Wine Country in 3 Days
subtitle: A TheTripNow pocket itinerary
author: TheTripNow
back_blurb: Three days in California wine country. Start in downtown Napa and Carneros, drive up the valley to St. Helena and Calistoga, then end in historic Sonoma and Jack London's Glen Ellen. Tasting fees and reservation tips, where to stay and eat, how to get around without driving after tasting, and a "Did you know?" at every stop. Practical, checked and pocket-sized.
sources_note: Every fact in this guide was checked on 15 November 2026 against official and published sources. The full list of sources is at thetripnow.com/sources/napa-sonoma.
